description:
Perform a non-parametric analysis on the Insect Sprays dataset. 

1. Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/InsectSprays.csv' in Jamovi.
2. Ensure 'count' is set as a Continuous variable and 'spray' as a Nominal variable.
3. Run a Kruskal-Wallis One-Way ANOVA with 'count' as the Dependent Variable and 'spray' as the Grouping Variable.
4. Enable 'DSCF' pairwise comparisons.
5. Enable 'Effect size' (epsilon-squared).
6. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/InsectSprays_KruskalWallis.omv'.
7. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/kruskal_wallis_report.txt' stating the Chi-squared value, p-value, epsilon-squared effect size, and which sprays appear most effective (lowest counts).
